reviews.author: Elizabeth Barth

reviews.text: My meal was great here! I went with my sister and we enjoyed our time and our server, Gilbert. Gilbert was wonderful and had conversations with us. I would definitely recommend him if you ever come, he made the experience so much better! Jose Luis was just as amazing when taking care of our table!
reviews.author: Renae Yellowman

reviews.text: We had a lovely experience at Luna! We ordered the lemon spaghetti and the agnolotti, both were delicious! I’ve had the lemon spaghetti at Giada’s in Las Vegas, the one at Luna was just as good. Our server Lynette was fantastic and Brody was so fun every time he stopped by our table.
reviews.author: Meredith O'Dwyer

reviews.text: Meh. For price and how popular Giada is, food was just ok for us. A la vodka pasta was just mediocre, all I could taste was  a little heat. No other levels of flavor really, just ok. Salmon was ok. Bland with canned artichokes with it which I thought was weird. Staff was great and best thing restaurant has going for it. Can give them a raise with the 500 bucks we spent on bland food and drinks ha. And Old Fashions should never come with crushed ice that's just a no no. Nothing we ordered would make us want to come back honestly 🤷
reviews.author: Megan Freemole Brown

reviews.text: Wanted to leave this place a good review, but both myself and my GF got massive food poisoning after eating their lobster bucatini. And then to top it off one of the waitstaff spilled some of the sauce from that dish onto my back which we were not told about and only noticed later in the evening (I was wearing a white shirt). And i am not the only one who thinks this place is not great for the money. Buying your foccacia bread from noble then pawning it off as your own after placing it in the pizza oven is not a great look.
reviews.author: Sam Camilli

reviews.text: First time visit and absolutely loved it. Defiantly a special occasion kinds of place. Lemon pasta was my favorite.
reviews.author: Robyn Sprague

reviews.text: Such a great experience having Tony as our server, will definitely be back!!
reviews.author: Olivia Gaugert

reviews.text: Was a wonderful evening great food and experience .Sheresse was amazing.  She was so helpful with great service and recommendations.
reviews.author: Stephanie McPherson

reviews.text: We came here on a Thursday night and had Shereese as our server! Her assistant Jacob came over immediately after we were seated and brought us waters and was very attentive throughout the entire evening. Shereese was very friendly and attentive as well. She was extremely knowledgeable about the menu and made great recommendations. Everything we had was phenomenal but Shereese truly was such a joy to talk to and definitely made our entire evening. Thank you so much Shereese and Jacob!
reviews.author: Brianna Sharp

reviews.text: I was so personally excited to be at this restaurant, I used to have all of Giadas cookbooks and made so many recipes religiously! I was so thankful to able to celebrate my mother's day at this beautiful, family style dining experience brought to us by the stunning Giada! The concept of the restaurant is fresh and bright food, a simple and elegant ambiance where they take the time to explain the menu and drinks! I also have to point out that the service was amazing and spot on, I was so impressed! Now the food was just absolutely incredible, every bite was bright in flavors and had such a wow factor amd the dishes were unique as well as classic and authentic Italian food! The drinks were so delightful as well as distinctive!!!
reviews.author: Nicole Franklin

reviews.text: 6 girlfriends visited last week for drinks and food and I couldn’t have been more disappointed. As a long time fan of Giada from watching her on the Food Network, I’ve been making some of her excellent recipes for years (Roman salad, salmon in lemon brodetto with pea puree among many others) and was excited to try her restaurant. I started with a cocktail which was ok, but not for $21, ocean club martinis are similar in price but twice the size, so not a great start. We then ordered a bottle of Chardonnay, came to the table warm, not one bit chilled. While waiting for other friends to arrive, I got to take in the decor and wanted to leave. I was dumbfounded by the cheap, fake greenery all over the bar, I’m talking $1.99 fake stems from Michael’s in a restaurant that is charging  $21 for a small cocktail or $25 for a glass of Cabernet. Additionally there was a dead palm in a pot next to our table.  On to the food, we ordered the specialty lemon pasta to split.  It was perhaps 5oz of pasta, piled into a nice swirl, it was ok, we split it 6 ways just to try so each bite cost $7! $42 for a tiny portion of pasta, no shellfish, no Kobe beef, just pasta in a lemon sauce for $7 a bite! Charcuterie board was slightly better, piquant Parmesan, some decent prosciutto de Parma but again the pricing was obscene at $60. I eat out frequently at high end restaurants, Steak 44, Ocean 44, Capital Grille, Maple and Ash, Fat Ox  (excellent) etc and am very willing to pay top dollar for top quality food and atmosphere. This place seriously missed the mark on all levels, overpriced food and drinks and terrible atmosphere . Save your money and try one of the other tried and true standbys (many I just listed). Note to Giada, if you want to charge LA/Malibu prices (our quick little happy hour cost us each $120 with tip) you’ll need to up your game. You’re way better than the product you presented.
reviews.author: Margaret Danner

reviews.text: Hubby and I had dinner there I’ve the weekend and got the spaghetti and porterhouse.  Food was good, service though was incredible.  Our server To y was so personable and honestly I would go back just for that alone again.  We haven’t had good service like this in years.  If you go request To y’s section.  You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Hermes Family

reviews.text: It was an amazing evening at Luna by Giada. Entrees were delicious, specifically the pizzas and pastas. Desserts were rich and filling, and we were lucky enough to be served by Tony, who was an exceptional waiter!
reviews.author: Christina Yamada

reviews.text: Everybody there was so friendly And made you feel welcome and the food was amazing , tony was our server and and gave us amazing service ( Thank you ) 😀
reviews.author: Patrick Gonzalez

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, friendly staff, but when we asked about some of the dishes they didn’t come out as described. The pork chop was supposed to be stuffed. They never said it was fried, came out looking like schnitzel. Paper thin, dry and very tough. The lemon pasta was mediocre and cold, we sent it back and they brought a better one but still not really hot. The filet was very good, ordered it without the egg, because of an allergy and the waitress brought it out with the egg and said to just scrape it off,  the filet was cooked perfectly and very good besides the egg issue. Might give it another try but not anytime soon. In general the staff is understaffed and over extended. Also if I’m in such a nice restaurant with very expensive menu prices the wait staff shouldn’t be in jeans and sneakers. They can do better.
reviews.author: Lori Boukis

reviews.text:
Had the absolute best experience for my sister in laws birthday! The entire evening was beautiful from start to finish. We had a literal team of amazing people waiting on us to ensure the best experience.

Shereese made the best recommendations, made us feel welcome and was so knowledgeable about everything! Austin and Andy were amazing too! We got to hear the story behind the constellation on the ceiling in the Jade Room!

To top things off, Giada stopped by our table and made our night! The food was delicious and she showed us the proper way to eat the lemon spaghetti!

Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Marsha

reviews.text: Overrated. Small portions. Lackluster service. Overpriced. Go somewhere else...
reviews.author: Carol Emmett

reviews.text: Great experience, insanely over priced! $50 for a pasta with chicken is robbery, but this is the place to go if you’re looking for 5 star dining and credit card points!
reviews.author: Lee Lorente

reviews.text: 10/10 best restaurant in Arizona. Restaurant is gorgeous, drinks were delicious, food was amazing, and service was great.
reviews.author: Elana Rose

reviews.text: My husband, step-daughter, and I tried Luna last night and it did not disappoint. From drinks to appetizers, the food was delicious. Our server was fantastic and was very informative, even letting the kiddo know that the bacon wrapped dates might be a bit spicy for her. The atmosphere was wonderful and everything you would expect from an upscale restaurant. The prices were honestly completely reasonable for the quality of food and service that was provided. My first Giada experience and I look forward to trying another in the future.
reviews.author: Kayla Dennis

reviews.text: We had a business meeting and dinner to check out the new hot spot in Scottsdale.  The place is new and the staff seems to be as well, but the service and food were top notch.  The manager "J" even came by to make sure everything was great and checked on us.  I will definitely recommend this to friends and family.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: My wife and I second time visiting This restaurant, and both times we are always so impressed with the first class service. The Vodka pasta with gluten free noodles is our favorite. This is definitely our favorite gluten free pasta dish in the valley. Our server Tony, was excellent, and really elevated our entire dinning experience. He was very friendly, and made superb suggestions and recommendations throughout their offerings. We hope to be back soon.
reviews.author: Michael Chaparro

reviews.text:
The atmosphere is fabulous. The lighting, table wear, and overall decor make the restaurant sophisticated yet young and “sexy”. 💃🏼

Now, let’s get serious and talk FOOD. The Margherita pizza is heavenly. The aragosta arancini are wonderful! 🤪

Unfortunately, the big let down, was the aragosta bucatini: the pasta was way overcooked!!!🫣

The staff working in the front is EXTREMELY cordial and professional.

Overall my friends and I had a very nice time, and would recommend the restaurant again as long as they insist on their pasta being AL DENTE.
reviews.author: Virginia “ItalianaVera” G.

reviews.text:
Everything was absolutely wonderful. From the beginning of service to the end. We even had the chance to meet Giada! She went table to table through the restaurant and it was incredible. She even showed us how to properly eat her famous Lemon Spaghetti. Our server, Shereese, was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. She recommended different menu items and they were all fabulous. We also had Andy and Austin taking care of us as well and they were so sweet and attentive.
The whole experience was wonderful. From the level of service, timing, pricing, atmosphere, a great menu with so many incredible items- it was just overall a wonderful experience.
Being in the restaurant industry for almost two decades, I know how much it takes, and this was a gem. Can’t wait to come back!
reviews.author: Nycolette Greggersen

reviews.text: I don’t really understand the overall rating because everything was fantastic ! From the service to one of the best pastas I’ve ever had, the Lemon pasta, and the focaccia. Can’t say enough good things. Also, my bf said the filet was one of the best he’s ever had! Thank you for such a lovely evening!
reviews.author: Mary Spedale

reviews.text:
My friends and I have dined at Luna by Giada twice in the last two weeks.  The bar staff is amazing and friendly.  They remembered our names and drink orders on the second visit.

The waiters are knowledgeable and personable.  Our server saw to our every request and offered his expertise when selecting  from the menu.

On both occasions, we met and talked with the Executive Chef CJ Kahley.  While he is in the kitchen most of the time, he came out to talk with many of the diners, not just us.  He is humble and confident in his technique and his team performs flawlessly.  He brought out selections of different appetizers for us all to try.

THE FOOD IS THE BOMB!!  It is the star of the show and a simple review does not give it its due.  First off, you have the have the focaccia bread!  It is airy, fluffy and full of flavor.  The pizzas are thin and cooked to perfection.  The entrees include pasta, seafood, and meat.  The menu itself is a curated selection of Giada's favorite dishes from her Italian heritage.  I have had most of the desserts in the 2 visits.  They are all exceptional.

Thank you to Paul, the GM, and all of the staff for two pleasant and memorable evenings!!
reviews.author: John Sowell

reviews.text:
I went there for dinner , food was very good, well crafted, atmosphere was nice, pleasant room and furniture yet the highlight of my dining experience was the server, Shereese!
Absolutely and hands down, one of the most thorough and professional wait person I met in my very long dining life, she truly is an asset, very precise and knowledgeable of the menu, nothing like a great waiter to enhance that wonderful dinner !!
I will be back!
reviews.author: Jean Dominique Charlas

reviews.text: I'm a huge fan of Giada and was super excited to go to Luna for my birthday. I was a little concerned based off the reviews but went in work an open mind. First off, our server Gilbert was PHENOMENAL! He was personable, funny, knew the menu well,  and gave awesome suggestions. We started with the foccacia and arugula salad. The salad is one of the best arugula salads I've ever had. We also ordered the lemon spaghetti, pork chop, scallop risotto, and vodka pasta. They were all very very good, but the vodka pasta was a little bland. I received the cookies and ice cream as a birthay treat, which was also really good, probably the best vanilla gelato I've tasted. I agree the pricing is a bit steep and it was noisy,  but my family and I were able to carry conversation no problem. As a person with pretty high expectations,  I thought Luna was great and didn't warrant a lot of the bad reviews it's received. Will definitely go back again
reviews.author: Jordan T

reviews.text: This was our first time in and we had an absolutely incredible experience. The service was great, the food was absolutely fantastic and the atmosphere is beautifully designed. Lemon spaghetti was delicious as was all the dishes we had. We had a large ten top table, so we ordered lots of different dishes for the table and there wasn’t one dish that wasn’t liked by everyone. I saw that they had some average reviews, but I can only speak to our experience which we all felt was a really great dinner with friends. Joe the GM of Caesars Republic stopped by our table to make sure that everything was to our liking. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Patrick Harrington

reviews.text: My expectations were clearly way too high because this place turned out to be an absolute disaster. When we got there, I thought it looked somewhat decent, but then we were crammed into this tiny table and chairs that were so close to the high table, it was beyond uncomfortable. It took a ridiculous 10-15 minutes just to order a drink, and when the white wine finally arrived, it was served warm. The room was so poorly designed that having a conversation was nearly impossible due to all the hard surfaces that made everything echo. And don't even get me started on the signature spaghetti with shrimp. It was drowning in that overpowering lemony cream sauce to the point where after a couple of bites, you're completely done. The prices were absolutely outrageous considering the quality, so if you go in expecting something good, you're in for a massive disappointment. Needless to say, there is absolutely no reason to ever go back there again.
reviews.author: Tom Sullivan

reviews.text: Luna by Giada surpassed our expectations from start to finish! All the staff were so friendly and greeted us with a smile but our waiter was the star of the night. Kenneth made us feel welcome, explained the menu, and made fabulous recommendations.  The Sicilian Foccocia, Seared Branzino, and Limoncello Soufflé were a few highlights.  Be prepared to pay Caesar’s added ‘venue’ fee. Excellent choice for a family celebration.
reviews.author: L Z

reviews.text:
Our first visit here, and it was very good.
The lemon spagetti and branzino were both very good.
Our cocktails were delicious and the bar staff were friendly and on point.

I would agree w other reviews that the pricing is not cheap, but the overall quality of the evening made it a great visit
reviews.author: wayne kaylor

reviews.text: This place is worse than Olive Garden.  Highway Robbery.  Stay away.
reviews.author: Chris Rogers

reviews.text: This place is beautiful,  great atmosphere! Our server, Ken, was outstanding, really made it such a lovely evening. The lemon pasta was delicious but only came with 2 shrimp.  Drinks were great too. Just know that it's small portions and quite pricey.
reviews.author: Andrea K

reviews.text: Wonderful experience - highlight was certainly the ambiance, service, focaccia bread, and handmade fresh pasta. Excellent new restaurant option in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Rachel Ewell

reviews.text: Ok for drinks, food is just not good
reviews.author: Ryan Evans

reviews.text:
Had an absolutely wonderful experience at Luna, which went well well beyond the food. We had the pleasure of meeting Ken our very lovely, lively and yet highly professional server. His personality was just so warm and energetic and yet he was able to steer us perfectly in the direction of what it was we wanted. Professional all the way but with a high level of emotional intelligence. Shereese and the FOH mgr were also wonderful. The decor throughout was impeccable and  just so stylish. Please keep decorum in mind when you decide to enjoy this perfect little gem and look your best. Luna deserves it. Oh and I'd be completely remiss if I didn't mention the abundance of lemon options (my personal favorite flavor profile)
So ask for Ken, look great,  and grab all the lemon options available especially the lemon soufflé.  Cheers!
reviews.author: Jill Danilewicz

reviews.text:
Service was good, staff was friendly and very attentive.

Atmosphere was ok.  The hostess was trying to explain the various dining areas but was talking straight ahead and we were  obviously behind her.  We could not hear a thing.  So, there may have been some meaning behind the decor but we wouldn’t know.

The price tag is outrageous for the quality of the plates.  We are from the NYC area and are use to paying a higher price for dining.  But unfortunately this was not worth it.

The risotto was the most disappointing.  It lacked depth, flavor.  Instead of being creamy and velvety it was stiff and clumpy.  Almost undercooked.  The peas felt out of place, under seasoned, I was looking for a pop of brightness but did not find it.

The chicken that accompanied our pasta dish was dry.  Nothing worse than paying $55 for dry chicken.

There is a 3.5% venue admin fee, AZ tax, plus tip.  So for 1 app, 1 pasta, and 1 risotto our bill came to about $170.  No drinks, no dessert, no main.

Maybe give them some time to get it together, it is difficult to open a restaurant.
reviews.author: Felicia Duran

reviews.text:
What amazing service! This restaurant really has customer service down to a "T". From the moment we approached the maitre'd stand to when we walked out, any staff member we interacted with was 100% fantastic. We were served by Tony, who took great care of us, kept our wine glasses full, chilled, and our plates full. He made some key recommendations on what and how to order that were totally on point. The pizza was very good, salads piled high. Agnolotti was delicious, but be warned, it's a very small portion for an entree.

My only criticism of the restaurant is the menu; an Italian restaurant without red sauce, ragu, lasagna or meat bolognese gives me pause. I found myself having to choose between a number of dishes that really didn't appeal to me.
reviews.author: Michael Taube

reviews.text: Definitely returning! Service Incredible, attention to details....  Thank you Everyone!
reviews.author: Antal Toth

reviews.text: Extremely noisy could not even have a conversation and ridiculously overpriced
reviews.author: david hall

reviews.text:
From entering Luna by Giada to dessert,  the staff w was welcoming and engaging! We never have to ask for anything for they were alert and attentive.
Chef Oscar came and greeted us and revisited our table several times. He was kind and knowledgeable making the experience even more enjoyable!
Soon we were approached by a lovely manager Kenny is also visited our table several times to make sure we were enjoying ourselves and had everything we needed.
Our server Gilbert was wonderful! Pure joy! He suggested the Caprese appetizer which he described as my very favorite Burrata cut open to expose the best part! BUT!! It did Not come as he described….it came as slices of mozzarella!??? I was very disappointed with that. But my sister Maria was very hungry and we ate it.
My drink was peachy! The best I’ve had! And our food was exceptional! The flavors perfection! My salmon was different from what I’ve ever had which made it very tasty. My only critique would be please take the stems off of the spinach…there is a potential choking factor there. Ugh.
Our table was by the door of the kitchen which gave us an excellent view of Giada’s beautiful Oven and the entire section of Luna highlighting the classic kitchen along with the stunning sunset beyond the mountain scape.
We enjoyed seeing guests walk in and even able to start conversations with them stopping by our table! A classic Italian old school chat like the old times!
The atmosphere is warm and comfortable allowing people to dress up or come in resort ware giving people the opportunity to be themselves! A feeling of being on vacation or even as if you were dining in a contemporary and stylish Italian Resturant that it is!
Finally dessert! I couldn’t stop eating! Chocolate Amaretti Cake!
We left and could not stop talking about the again exceptionally flavorful food and the fabulous dessert and my delicious drink!
During the time we were there I noticed one of the sun shades was stuck and twisted just above a table of three…within minutes the hotel Instead instead it fixed within 15 minute with no disruptions to the guests. They also immediately took care of a empty locked stall in the Womens restroom! I bring these up because it’s attention to detail and the safety and convince of the guests that is top priority.
Bravo Giada! We are so happy you are here!
reviews.author: Christine Demas

reviews.text:
Last night (4/16), my boyfriend and I tried Luna by Giada. As a fan of Giada, I'd been really looking forward to it, but with a seemingly heavy tip culture on the rise everywhere and yet a noticable decline with service quality, we weren't expecting to be wowed. Our experience last night happily restored our faith that there are still places out there that truly care about the experience as much as the food. Everything was incredible! The restaurant is beautiful, the glass walled kitchen was really cool to watch, and the views of the sunset were great!

Our server, Shereese, couldn't have been more helpful! She walked us through the menu, highlighted her favorites, and asked about our tastes and recommended items based on what we were looking for. Caught between quite a few dishes and drinks, her suggestions helped our decision-making, and getting to know her throughout our night, we just felt right at home. She was warm, friendly, attentive, and hilarious.

The food was just as spectacular too! I normally would shy away from spaghetti or a heavier pasta at a new place because I wanted to try a few items,  but I am so glad she recommended the lemon spaghetti. It was light, with a burst of lemon cutting the typical heaviness of Alfredo sauce, and the salty capers had a great crunch. I'm already craving it again since there weren't leftovers, ha. The crab arancini was delicious, and the red sauce had a bit of spiciness to it that perfectly complemented the crab. We also tried the caprese and really liked the addition of balsamic pearls. My boyfriend had the Nodi Marini Alla Vodka with sausage recommended by Shereese. He loved the addition and the dish! For dessert, we shared a light and creamy vanilla bean cheesecake with a cookie crust and espresso caramel sauce. That sauce! Wow! You've gotta get it in every bite. We tried two cocktails as well, a cucumber kiwi Vodka that was really refreshing, not too sweet, and a pink gin drink that reminded me a little bit of a pink starburst. So good! Again, both were recommended by our wonderful server.

Last night felt really special and we weren't celebrating anything, just spending time together. We'll definitely be back and asking for Shereese if she's available. You should, too.
reviews.author: Kristin Frank

reviews.text: We went to celebrate a birthday dinner on a Thursday evening. Our server was either still in training or was training someone (unable to determine why we had two people working with us) and that normally doesn't bother us but neither of them were super knowledgeable about the menu. One of us had a dairy allergy and the only options were pizza without cheese or a pasta with marinara. I don't blame the servers for this, I blame management and the higher ups. This is in Scottsdale where all other restaurants have numerous options for GF/Dairy allergies. Another annoyance of the evening was cocktails took over 15 minutes and it was around 845 when the restaurant was slowing down. Maybe I'll try it again in a year when they've worked out the kinks...
reviews.author: Cydney F.

reviews.text: We had a great time experiencing different items on the menu. It’s a hip, energetic place.
reviews.author: Courtney Nichols

reviews.text:
Melanie and Andy were great.
Food was delicious the Franzino OMG. A piece of ART.
reviews.author: Oscar Rodriguez

reviews.text: Amazing food.  Homemade lemon pasta was ridiculous; must try.  Brandy took great care of & we will be back.
reviews.author: Lisa E

reviews.text: Wow lemon spaghetti with lobster so good. Brandi was our server and she was amazing. Some great gluten free pasta for my kids.
reviews.author: Troy Swope

reviews.text: Checked out this place a week after it opened. I must say I had a great experience all around. It was a beautiful restaurant. The staff was very warm and welcoming upon entering, the servers were knowledgeable and attentive, and the filet, asparagus, and cheesecake were bomb! Let’s not forget about the great cocktails! Definitely going back to try some other menu items.
reviews.author: Tim Truong

reviews.text: Giada's Luna restaurant in Scottsdale offers a mixed experience. While the food was okay, it didn't quite reach the level of greatness expected. Prices leaned towards the expensive side, which may not justify the overall dining experience. However, the standout aspect was the exceptional service, adding a positive note to the visit. The ambience was very nice. The food on the other hand was mediocre at best.
reviews.author: Andrew M

reviews.text:
We were very excited for the opening of Luna by Giada in Scottsdale, as we have tried her Las Vegas  restaurant several times and really liked.
We had horrible service at the new location with a terrible attitude by server and runners to the table.  They acted like they didn’t want to be there& couldn’t be bothered by our table of five.
We ordered lots of cocktails, wines, appetizers, entrees and dessert.  Portions were much smaller than other location with same or higher pricing.
We reached out to management on a private message in open table the day after dining, and they have yet to respond.  Sadly disappointing, not sure with all the other great restaurants in the Phoenix/ Scottsdale area, if we’ll ever have any desire to go back.  So sad:(
reviews.author: Marcia S.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our date night out! Service was great, however you do have to figure out the purse situation as you can’t hang them on the chairs and the tables are small, need stands like most upscale restaurants. Accommodate the ladies!
The lemon spaghetti was to die for, my husband tried mine and liked it more than his Arribata pasta. The shrimp were great but only two. They were big though. The portions were great, the oysters and broccolini and citrus Caesar were stand outs. To only have one cab by the glass was a little disappointing for an Italian place. I ended up ordering the Fraust bottle which was good.
Tiramisu was very good but more of a mousse. Food came quickly. We will be back!
reviews.author: Bridjette Shelfo

reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our dinner at Luna by Giada. We started off with fantastic drinks at the bar while we waited for our table. The service was attentive and our waiter, Jay, made excellent recommendations for our food and drinks.

The petit filet was perfectly cooked and was accompanied by the best mashed potatoes we have ever tasted. The tripolini pasta was delicious. We tried tiramisu and the marscapone cheesecake brownie for dessert and loved every bite.

I highly recommend Luna for your next dinner out!
reviews.author: Aimee Troncale

reviews.text: This is an Italian cafeteria with five-star service, that somehow tries to pass off Costco’s La Marca by the bottle as a luxury. It is not fine dining, fyi so don’t expect it to be. The service was great - plenty of nice, 5-star people serving. Thought it was entertaining to see everyone dressed in their Sunday best to come to what reminiscences a Carrow’s diner.
reviews.author: Kira Brown

reviews.text:
Michael Rossi is a master of hospitality.

His dedication to the guest, deserves an award.

Will be back to see Michael
reviews.author: Ryan Henderson

reviews.text: Great experience, friendly welcoming staff,  Kennith was our waiter well done!  Food was great, the restaurant of still young looking forward to see it again and explore. The menu!  Get the Lemon Pizza and the beef cheek raviolis.  Nice work to the hosts in front - big job for one person she is a keeper!
reviews.author: James smith

reviews.text: Went here for a birthday, was extremely well received by Kenny the manager, he is super friendly and attentive, our server was Tony and he was incredible as well, very helpful with tips about the menu and the food was really really great. Crab Arancini is a must, the Agnolotti is on the smaller side but really well made and their chocolate ice cream is the best I have ever had. For sure going back more often. The place is also very beautiful.
reviews.author: Renata Marchand

reviews.text: To start off the menus are photo paper. Glossy in the front matte in the back. Very cheap & underwhelming. They are also hard to read because the lettering is a light color. The food was so bland & the pasta was over cooked. I ordered the lemon spaghetti & there was no hint of lemon flavor at all. Very disappointed the only thing that was good was the foccocia. My husbands scallops were under cooked. The only good thing about this restaurant was our waiter Tucker he was amazing. We spend over $100 for boring food.
reviews.author: Alba Gonzalez

reviews.text: Ok the place is new.  BTW it’s not Applebees. So don’t expect to pay their prices…but if you want a cool place for a date or anniversary, it’s really good.
reviews.author: Michael Hayes Speaks

reviews.text:
We can to celebrate our in-laws anniversary and were expecting something really delicious. However the lemon past has a lack of flavor and came with only two shrimp. One order chose scallops, again only two scallops came on the plate. The stuffed pasta in broth lacked any flavor as well. My cocktail was supposed to have blood orange and instead it contained grapefruit. One pasta dish never came, and the bill was incorrect oh lastly we ordered a sausage pizza with no cheese for our son. It came out with cheese.
On a positive the crab rice balls were great and so was the calamari.
reviews.author: Vincent Cicillini

reviews.text: Delicious food!!!!  Unfortunately the terrible service outweighed the food.  Yes it’s expensive but we expected that.. although when we spend that kind of money we expect top notch service and it was not there … our appetizers came and our wine was served 20 minutes later!  We had to flag our server down to order our main course he said he’d be right back and never came… we finally got a manager to take our order.  We were celebrating my birthday and the manager came after our meal and more waiting and offered to bring a birthday dessert for our inconvenience! It was unbelievable that the service was so bad!
reviews.author: Nancy T

reviews.text:
The food was excellent. Had the salmon and lemon Cacio de Pepe. Tony was our server and was the kindest and most accommodating server. He made great suggestions, listened to our requests and brought the food out exactly as we had ordered it. He made us feel very welcome and was most attentive!
We look forward to trying again soon and enjoy some other dishes that looked good!
reviews.author: Amy Cohn

reviews.text: $35 for a 2oz pour of Woodford Reserve for a Manhattan????? Ok, I get that you’re a luxury brand, but that’s a bit excessive! I can buy a BOTTLE for $29! Apparently I was up charged for a large cube….its freakin WATER!
reviews.author: Jason Guitar Playa

reviews.text: Absolutely incredible food. The servers were very attentive. 10/10 recommend
reviews.author: Nicole Whyte

reviews.text: Caprese Excellent.  Branzino & Rosotto ..amazing!  Souffle outstanding.  Highly recommend.  Ray was an excellent server....very personable.  Can't wait to go back.
reviews.author: Susan Sharp

reviews.text: Great service and good food.
reviews.author: sue weber

reviews.text: Our recent visit to Luna by Giada was unfortunately disappointing. The spicy sausage pizza, priced at $28, was covered in raw oregano, which overwhelmed the flavor of the sausage and made the dish unpleasant. Similarly, the agnolotti, priced at $41, was greasy and soupy, lacking the delicate balance of flavors and textures I had hoped for. Both dishes were served in small portions, which was disappointing given the prices. The scallop risotto, also priced at $41, was good but served in a small portion (two small scallops). The margherita pizza, priced at $28, was very bland and floppy. The service was acceptable, and the staff were attentive. The ambiance of the restaurant was overly bright, which, combined with the decor, left the feeling of a casino cafeteria rather than an upscale dining experience. With so many fantastic restaurants in Scottsdale there are better options.
reviews.author: Chase “Mr Chase”

reviews.text:
Hi Giada! I’ve been following you for years on Food Network & have been a big fan of all your cookbooks!

My significant other took me tonight for my 47th birthday to your new restaurant Luna in Old Town Scottsdale, AZ.

Unfortunately, it was the worst restaurant experience that I’ve ever had. For my birthday, they threw 2 plastic wrapped cookies at me as if it was at McDonald’s “happy meal”. It was very disheartening & tacky! Especially, after ordering apps, entrees & a bottle of wine…along with/ cocktails earlier in the evening. Even when the server approached the manager… The manager said this is how we do it from now on.

I will still continue to purchase your cookbooks, but doubt that I will ever return to one of your establishments ever again.

Very disappointed!
reviews.author: April Press

reviews.text: My wife and I visited Luna by Giada for dinner on a Saturday night. The atmosphere of the  restaurant is quite nice, however, we were seated in one of the dining rooms, and the noise was so loud we were unable to really have a conversation. The service was great and our waiter was warm and welcoming. The meal started off ok with the appetizer we ordered. We ordered the bacon wrapped dates which were probably the best thing we ate all night. This is when things started to go downhill. I ordered the agnolotti and was quite disappointed when the dish was placed in front of me as it was pretty expensive and for $41 I received 9-10 small pieces of pasta and broth (picture of the dish included). Our waiter even tried to play off the size of the dish when he collected my plate at the end of our meal, stating he wished the portion was 2 -3 times bigger, needless to say I left hungry. My wife ordered the Nodi Marini Alla Vodka and our waiter had suggested adding a chicken breast to the dishes as it was vegetarian, big mistake. The chicken breast was dry and overcooked and lacked flavor (not to mention the addition costed $16), her pasta was mediocre at best. For dessert we had heard about the limoncello soufflé and we’re excited to try it, personally I thought the dessert was fine. My wife was not a fan and thought it tasted to heavily like eggs. This entire experience was such a disappointment as my wife and I are big fans of Giada, however, we can’t justify coming back here in the future based on the cost and quality of food.
reviews.author: Christopher Singh

reviews.text:
The food was not good for the price. Pasta was uncooked and shrimp were overcooked.
The dessert and rice crab balls were the best.
They charge $10 for still water!!!!! Is that even ethical?! I won’t be a returning diner.
reviews.author: Jordann Pinder

reviews.text:
The food was an 11/10.
We had the bacon wrapped dates, lemon pizza, and the nodi marini alla vodka and added chicken.

Highly recommend ordering those three to start.

Best pizza I’ve had in a while. The crust was amazing soft, chewy with a light crisp! The lemon pizza was def the star.

Can’t wait to go back and try more.

Service was amazing, prompt and attentive.. however our reservation was later in the night (9:45pm)

Atmosphere was good.. don’t expect Thea global ambassador vibes.. it was more relaxed.

Good for a romantic date night.
reviews.author: Margaret Tran

reviews.text: After an hour waiting for our food, the waitress came over and said, I know this is a silly question but, did you get your food!!! Terrible she hadn’t come over earlier. The manager came over said he was sorry . Took my email never did anything.  The worst part was when I went to get my car from valet and they tried to give me some else’s car insisting it was mine.
reviews.author: C C

reviews.text: Poor delayed start of service.  Waited almost 20 minutes after being seated before waitress showed up with menus. Went back in hiding for a bit. The rest of staff stepped up and meal ended on a positive note. Very good food and worth a try.
reviews.author: Scott Porambo

reviews.text: Out party of 6 had a wonderful time dining at Luna’s for the first time! Mike S. got us all set up with the reservation and his staff took excellent care of us! Our waiter Tucker was very knowledgeable on the entire menu and gave us several excellent suggestions. The margherita pizza, lemon spaghetti, and agnolotti were our favorites! Can’t wait to go back and try more dishes!
reviews.author: Craig Yarnell

reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time dining at Luna and it's a tale of 2 restaurants!  Our first visit they had been open only 2 weeks and everything was fabulous from the drinks to the food to the service.  Our second visit, just this week was not great (at all),  It's like the kitchen and service staff forgot what they learned during training!?!
Food: Burrata salad was not like the first visit, this time there was a smear of cheese on the bottom of the plate, it should have been called tomato salad because the nice cheese we had on our first visit was not there.  Chicken was dry and the side 'salad' was brown mush, the veg had been way overcooked.  Branzino, again not like the first visit, skin was not crisp and both plates (2 people got Branzino) were missing the puree that the filets are supposed to rest on top of, we were served 2 random filets on a plate.
Service: Tony was our server, we requested him because he did such an amazing job our first visit.  He again was great, very knowledgeable but had WAY too many tables.  The food runners need help/training!  Every time they brought a dish they tried to give it to the wrong person, they dropped and left, never explaining the food (if they had let's hope they would have noticed the missing puree under the fish and the sad looking pile of veg with the chicken), even the person filling the water was never around.  Maybe the expediter took the night off?

We had bragged to our friends about the food and service (we have been to Giada's in Vegas a few times together), which sadly just wasn't up to par.
Please get it together, we want this place to be great like our first visit.
reviews.author: Dawn Ingram

reviews.text: Walk-in to the bar...no one greeted me, I sat for 5 mins before being acknowledged.  While sitting at the bar a child was allowed to sit there, even though there was an adult I thought I was at an upscale restaurant/bar.  Menu was unreadable..print was small and in light colors, I was told this was not final draft.  I used the online menu which does not include the cocktails.  I ordered the risotto which was labeled to include scallops and crab, I only saw the 2 large scallops, peas and asparagus.   Most of the risotto was crunchy/chewy.  I tried to order tiramisu but was told this was unavailable for take home.  Overall unimpressed with my experience
reviews.author: heather

reviews.text: Beautiful experience at Luna for my birthday last night! Sherise (not sure of spelling), our server, was so thoughtful and explained everything to us, for the best experience! I loved all of the attention to detail, from the dishware, to the decor. The caprese salad was like eating art, and all of the pasta was perfect.
reviews.author: Kim K

reviews.text: Very disappointed.  We were visiting from Wisconsin and wanted to celebrate our son 50th bday.  Let 3 messages and someone was suppose to return my call and no response.  It was a very big let down to me and the family.   I think it was irresponsible that no one could return my call. Probably will not go back
reviews.author: Patti Lanza

reviews.text: The food was delicious! We started with the Caprese salad, which was outstanding, and then we moved on to a pizza. The crust on the pizza was so delicious and so much better than anything I’ve ever had before. Of course we had to have the lemon pasta outstanding.!!!! Wait, we finished with the lemon soufflé, that was beyond anything I’ve ever had except in Paris!!!! I can’t wait to go back!!!!!
reviews.author: Ellen Silverman

reviews.text: Great food and great experience! Giada makes it very special!!
reviews.author: George Romas

reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere but food is basic at best.
reviews.author: Thomas and Jaime

reviews.text: Our group was provided phenomenal service by Shereese and Parker tonight! Not only was their service top notch, but they made phenomenal recommendations and were both professional and personable. Additionally, all our orders were delicious from the arugula salad to the antipasti platter to the scallops in risotto and the vodka pasta. If you really want something to top off the delicious dinner you had, order the brownie mascarpone cheesecake. It is decadence without being too rich! We will be back.
reviews.author: EST. Home Collective

reviews.text:
First off, let me say if you're going here, ask for Tony as your waiter! Very nice gentleman, very relaxed and laid-back, very attentive all around just a good quality guy, someone that you can trust will make the correct recommendation for you.
Absolutely love the restaurant food was amazing people were amazing drinks were really good they are still working out the Kinks cuz they've only been open for a couple of weeks but all in all I will be back there as many times as they will have me back!
Caesar's Republic is a beautiful new hotel right next to Fashion Square in Ocean 44 in Old Town Scottsdale. After you're done eating, we recommend you go up to the 7th floor and check out the view. There aren't too many better views in all of Scottsdale in my opinion.

The only issue we had the whole night were the lights in the dining room area. They would come on and then they would dim all the way to off and then come back on we just chalked it up to it being a brand new restaurant and still trying to work out the Kinks in the building.
reviews.author: Nate Block

reviews.text: I had an incredible experience here. The food was outstanding and memorable. The salmon was perfectly seasoned and perfectly seared - crispy on the outside while still soft and jucy. It was served with artichoke hearts, cannellini beans, and sun-dried tomatoes with a butter sauce. The lemon potatoes were also crispy and flavorful and a perfect complement to the entree. The signature cocktail was refreshing and balanced. It had kiwi and cucumber and I could have had a pitcher of it! Service was top notch. Cheyenne at the bar was knowledgeable and friendly and attentive. Deanna the hostess was lovely and accommodating. The restaurant is gorgeous and I found the silverware and glassware to be particularly elegant and satisfying to the touch. Even the general manager, Jay,  introduced himself to me, a solo diner. I can't wait to try the branzino next!
reviews.author: Gary Roudkovski

reviews.text: Not the Italian Giada food we thought there would be (Ravioli, Lasagna rolls, etc.) Felt like so many menu items were lemon based?? Not sure what that’s about. Food was good, but nothing I’d rave about. One of those “It was nice to try, but I don’t need to go back” restaurants, unfortunately.
reviews.author: Ashley Riedel

reviews.text: The foccacia bread is to die for. I highly recommend it. The ambiance is incredible. I look forward to my next visit.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: What a great restaurant! Service was amazing and the food was fantastic.  Kari the manager (not sure if I spelled name correctly) was so accommodating and really made you feel welcome.  Shereese our server was extremely knowledgeable and gave us great recommendations!  We look forward to going back soon!
reviews.author: Missy Tews

reviews.text: We were at the grand opening of Luna. The food was off the charts. We started with Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp and Capers. Delicious. Focaccia bread was outstanding. Caesar salad was delicious. Caprese salad was like a burrata drenched in olive oil topped with tomato’s. So good. Pork saltibucco was outstanding. Finished with hot chocolate chip cookies and lemon cookies. Can’t wait until our next visit! 5 stars
reviews.author: Jim Pierson

reviews.text: The salmon was perfect, the service was top notch, and the ambiance was lively. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert D

reviews.text: Was welcomed in, reservation on time, staff was super friendly and informative. We sat in the jade room, a tribute to giadas daughter and was a great experience. We started with the antipasti plater which was top tier, I went with then scallop risotto and my wife went with the seared branzino, which were both exquisite. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ben Turner

reviews.text:
How you handle the little things, will reflect on the whole. Our first reaction as we walked in was one of a beautiful location and wonderful atmosphere while getting a beautiful view of the kitchen. I am notating that the service from several of the staff should be a 3. But the reason I still put it as a 5 is because our server Seth was a 10. Prompt but did not linger and was managing multiple tables very well. Ask for Seth from NYC.

We went with a variety of dishes between three of us. Crab Arancini, Sicilian Foccacia, Lemon Pasta, Risotto, and the lemon pizza.

Crab Arancini was delicious, it was only a little over salted.
I will remember the small things and the Sicilian Focaccia was incredible. Light, fluffy and crispy perfection.
The risotto was the other highlight with a perfectly seared scallop and well prepared and presented dish.
The Lemon pizza is not something I would try but it was delightful.  Good crust and good flavor. There was some extra pesto left over from
The Focaccia and that was great to dip the crust in.
The last dish was the lemon pasta. It was good and well prepared, personally I would have preferred it with a lighter linguini noodle as it felt a bit heavy but still was good.
The three of us were too full for desert but it all looked delicious as it was walked by. Would recommend checking out if you are in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Jacob Bell

reviews.text: Our server Tony was amazing! Ask for him for sure! They were booked up for all large parties, but our waiter went above and beyond putting us in a private room to accompany all 7 of us!  We were entertained for my mom’s birthday and enjoyed delicious food which came out SO fast!
reviews.author: Diana Bernstein

reviews.text: We were so excited about going to this restaurant as I have always enjoyed Giada's cooking show. We were all very disappointed  - the waiter Seth was horrible - he seemed like he was in a rush so really didn't spend much time helping us with the menu. We all had an appetizer, pasta, main meal then cappuccino  - we were going to have dessert but after the meal and cappuccino we decided it wouldn't be worth it. We unfortunately had to return our cappuccino as one was very bitter and the other two were both tepid.  Don't waste your time and money - definitely not worth it. This is the 1st time I have posted a negative review.
reviews.author: Francine Curtis

reviews.text:
BE WARE OF THE CREDIT CARD FEE ON YOUR BILL.
We dined at Luna one week after they opened for business. The food was pretty good, the service was okay, that’s understandable that they just open and they need time to refine the service. The prices are on the high side, however that’s also understandable for being in Scottsdale. The main reason for giving the two star rating is the credit card fee that was added to our bill without letting us know of that charge. We realized  it the next day when we  looked at the bill again. The prices are high enough to cover their credit card fees and they don’t need to pass that on to the customers. Shady.
reviews.author: rae Ham

reviews.text: Great service, with even better food. Tony was amazing, and did such a good job explaining everything on the menu!
reviews.author: Sarah Thygesen

reviews.text: A 3.5% venue fee! Are you kidding me!
reviews.author: Over Kill007

reviews.text:
Seating for two could have been better. The restaurant was not at capacity but we were sat at the very last seat at the end of the restaurant. I understand zones but.. being a new restaurant I would imagine they would sit you towards the center of the restaurant to make a better impression, cozier dining experience.

Ambience: Music can be turned down a bit. Purse holders are definitely needed due to chair design not allowing for easy hanging.

We had the Lobster Bucatini for two. The pasta needs to be shorter, especially if served in the center for two… there was no end to the pasta, really messy to serve. I would suggest maybe serving it for the guest or providing better utensils to share (not a knife).

Loved the hints of lemon through out the dishes. Overall enjoyed our visit but I feel needs small improvements to be great.
reviews.author: Harol Lainez

reviews.text: Still riding high the next morning from our dinner at Luna last night.  Our server, Tucker, was so personable and attentive.  Our favourites were the Arancini, Risotto and the Salmon.  We will definitely be back in the future.
reviews.author: Murray Sali

reviews.text: We were greeted with a smile and sat quickly for our reservation. Our first round of drinks took 25 to 30 minutes to receive, just barely before our apps hit the table. Our apps were only ok. After many questions about the various dishes, we ordered a few entrees to share with the table. The food came to the table before we had plates, so we had to wait on eating on our food. Honestly, the food was only ok, especially for the prices.The lemon pasta was under-cooked and did not have much flavor. The steak (that was well over $100) was simply not that good. I feel the menu could do a better job of explaining the dishes because many items like the carpaccio and bolognese are not traditional by any means. As a person who loves to dine out, I do not feel the quality of the food matches the prices. I hope this only due to being newly open. It is a beautiful restaurant and hope these issues get resolved.
reviews.author: Heather W

reviews.text: This restaurant is beautiful! I love being able to see inside the kitchen and all the decor we saw on the way to our seat. We ordered the Ala Vodka, Frrito Misto, La Strada Cocktail, Lemon Pizza, and Margarita Pizza. The calamari(Frrito Misto) was so crispy and flaky, loved it. The Ala Vodka was amazing as well, not spicy at all and creamy. I wanted to order the Citrus Oasis Cocktail however they were out of the limoncello at 6pm. I asked for a mojito however they just gave me the La Strada instead. Our waiter Tucker was great however I noticed on our bill he over charged us by a lot on a couple items. They charged us 2x of the Margarita Pizza and Frrito Misto when we only ordered 1 item. We would’ve completely missed it since we all have been drinking but one of us caught the mistake luckily. Also we had reservations at 6pm and didn’t leave til 9:30pm because they took so long bringing items out to our table, they also took awhile to take our drink order. We also ordered the cheesecake which looked amazing however it was hard as a rock and we could barely cut into it, they said they premade the cheesecake and left it in the freezer and the pastry chef left. It’s crazy how it took over 15min for a cheesecake to come out especially since it was premade and just in the freezer. We then ordered a gelato which took another 10min to come out. My waiter kept saying that it was other people ringing in our food however he was the only person we told what we wanted so I don’t understand why we were overcharged on several items. I was really hoping the service would be better since it’s such a nice place. I’m thinking since this place is new they have a couple things to work out.
reviews.author: Hunter Lejano

reviews.text: I understand it’s the first week so I understand if there is a bit of a service issue. But the prices are rediculous. It can’t possibly survive with these prices. The exact same cocktail was $3 less in NYC. I was unimpressed by the $60 antipasta. Let me cut it short. I was unimpressed by all the food, including the dessert (tiramisu) in Italy it’s the law that you can not charge over $2 for espresso. Here it’s $8. In Italy, the sparkling water is free. Nope not here. Ok I’ll get away from the prices. We had the lobster and pasta. Meh. Tasted the ala vodka. Unimpressed, tasted the risotto. Also unimpressed. I so wanted to like it. We brought the whole family. If the food was fabulous I’d say OK. I’ll pay top $ for really good food. It was also very loud, but laid out beutifully. And it’s spotless. So, I’ll say, good luck.
reviews.author: Gina Z

reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Good was good but not exceptional
reviews.author: Ashley Koenig

reviews.text:
Our server Tucker, was awesome, very knowledgeable and helpful.
Food was more than delicious,  the crab arancini, we thought we died and went to heaven, stuffed with so much crab and the perfect crunch! Foccacia was so soft and fluffy.  Mortadella pizza, perfect crust and pistachios added a wonderful crunch. Save room for Lemoncello souffle,  OMG....it was so light, melt in your mouth fantastic! Definitely will be back.
reviews.author: JoAnne

reviews.text:
Beautiful location and upscale vibes. Tables weren't packed too close and the staff were extremely hospitable at every step. Signature craft cocktails at $21 was a bit surprising, but were indeed delicious. Had mid expectations tbh but the food was absolutely delicious all around. Focaccia was devine, arugula salad was great as well.  Nodi alla vodka pasta was tasty but not really creamy. Lemon spaghetti was the star of the show though! Simple flavors but so well excuted, and perfectly cooked shrimp.

Agree that overall, the prices are steep, but the food is quite delicious. Truthfully expected these prices with this being a sparkly new Ceasar's location in the heart of Scottsdale. Feels similar to designer label clothes, you know the value isn't quite there and you're paying a name markup, but you know what you're in for.

Do absolutely recommended for a nice night out or celebratory occasion.
reviews.author: Austin Paine

reviews.text:
This is our new go-to place! The whole experience was amazing from start to finish and I can’t wait to be back! The whole staff was so on top of it to make sure we had the best experience- specifically the managers Ray and Keri and our server Tucker (he made great suggestions!). The restaurant is absolutely stunning with cute little touches from Giadas life and the kitchen was SPOTLESS. It a full open kitchen so it was awesome to see the team work together so well even in the first few days of being open.
Now the important part- the food!
We got a little bit of everything and every bite was so yummy!
Highly suggest the crab arancini, margarita pizza, ANY of the pastas and the tiramisu or the cookies for dessert (the chocolate chip cookie was to die for!).
Overall this was one of the best dinners we’ve had in Scottsdale. Highly suggest trying to get a reservation! You may even run into Giada. ❤️
reviews.author: Avery Rutkowsky

reviews.text: Great new restaurant in Scottsdale.  Seth and the entire staff have done an amazing job.  Food was fantastic and the atmosphere was great.  Definitely going back
reviews.author: Alex Patent

reviews.text: You will not be disappointed! Luna by Giada gets everything right.  Starting from the hostess to servers to food and the atmosphere.  Every dish we had was fabulous!
reviews.author: Sarina Bergman

reviews.text: Beautiful location and decor. Great food. The staff is friendly and inviting.  Can’t wait til we’re back in Scottsdale again.
reviews.author: beth myres

reviews.text:
WOW. Giada has a winner!

The food/experience was simply incredible.
Their cucumber cocktail "La Strada"and Bourbon "Moderno" are highly recommended. The pizza appetizer was outstanding. Lemon Spaghetti Shrimp and Pork Saltimbocca must be experienced!
Kenneth our server provided appropriately prompt, helpful, friendly service, adding to our certainly becoming regulars.  You will be hard pressed to find a better Italian dinner then at Luna, anywhere.
reviews.author: Peter Taylor

reviews.text: Food, service, and ambiance all hit the marks but the prices are a bit delusional. Giada nails it with lemons and parmesan here, especially on the lemon pizza and lemon pasta. Why is a generic fritto misto $27 though? The lemon aioli was fantastic but we're missing a few grams of truffles at this price point. Salad selection is abysmally mediocre unfortunately. The crispy skin on the branzino was very well executed and great flavors on the pork chop, just at the wrong price point for not-so-luxury dishes. Get there at sunset and enjoy the fantastic views!
reviews.author: Gregory Puckett

reviews.text: Fantastic experience and our waiter Seth was so helpful with recommendations and prompt service.
reviews.author: West Sands

reviews.text: Fresh Italian food by one of the best chefs in the world- yes please. You will not be dissapointed by the service and menu. Pictures of the epic food coming soon!!!!!
reviews.author: Yasser Sanchez

reviews.text:
You go Giada!!! It's gonna be awesome!!!! Can't wait!
Whoohoo!!!!
reviews.author: Jacklyn Montanez
